Braille Translation Components

The ASCII braille view uses the louis-rs braille translator and embeds
Hebrew braille tables from the liblouis project. Both are licensed under the
GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later. Their source code
is available at the projects' repositories.

louis-rs: https://github.com/liblouis/louis-rs
liblouis tables: https://github.com/liblouis/liblouis
License text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html
